No production layout/font change.

optional_thread_dump.meaning: A jstack request for the measurement JVM reported non existent JVM pid after that JVM had already completed. No thread dump, source diagnosis or acceptance result was obtained.

escaped_response_id.meaning: Final bounds review identified response growth from a maximally escaped request ID. Metadata now returns a signed/correlated LIMIT_EXCEEDED within 2 KiB instead of falling through to an unsigned transport error; subsequent requests remain usable.
